skill.name: context-persistence
skill.description: Guides AI coding assistants to preserve task context with waypoint plans, progress notes, and resume-ready checklists.
skill.summary: Create waypoint documentation so long-running coding work can resume after resets or interruptions.
skill.author: DojoCodingLabs

security_audit.summary: All 55 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced examples, and prose examples in SKILL.md. The remaining concern is operational: stale waypoint notes could mislead a future session if users do not refresh them.

content.user_title: Preserve Project Context Across AI Coding Sessions
content.value_statement: Long AI coding sessions can lose decisions, progress, and next steps after resets. This skill defines waypoint files that preserve context for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Defines a three-file waypoint structure for plans, context, and tasks.
Explains how to record session progress, blockers, decisions, and next actions.
Provides templates for quick resume instructions after a context reset.
Describes when to create, update, and archive waypoint plans.
Documents example slash-command workflows for create, update, resume, and archive actions.
limitations: It does not automatically verify that documentation matches the current code state.
It depends on users or agents updating progress notes accurately.
It can add unnecessary process for trivial or single-step changes.
It does not replace version control, issue tracking, or secure secret handling.

use_cases.title: Resume Long Features
use_cases.description: Keep a clear record of completed work, current files, and next steps for multi-session implementation tasks.

use_cases.title: Hand Off Project State
use_cases.description: Document decisions, blockers, and active tasks so another contributor can continue work with less setup time.

use_cases.title: Recover After Context Reset
use_cases.description: Give an AI assistant a concise path back into the task after history loss or a long interruption.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Waypoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new multi-session task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a waypoint plan for this task. Include a strategic plan, current context, and an actionable task checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Update Current Progress
prompt_templates.scenario: Routine update after completing meaningful work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the waypoint context with what is complete, what is in progress, blockers, files changed, and the exact next action.

prompt_templates.title: Resume From Existing Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue after a break or context reset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the active waypoint files, summarize the current state, verify the next action, and continue from the documented point.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Stale Waypoint State
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review when documentation may be outdated.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the waypoint context against the current repository state, identify stale assumptions, update the task list, and propose the next safe step.

output_examples.input: A developer asks to start a payment integration that may take several sessions.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a waypoint with a strategic plan, a session progress section, and task phases with acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: A user returns after a context reset and asks to continue authentication work.
output_examples.output: The assistant reads the context notes, reports completed items, names the current file, and resumes the documented next action.

output_examples.input: A team member needs to take over an interrupted refactor.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes decisions, blockers, modified files, and remaining tasks so the handoff is direct and actionable.

best_practices: Update session progress after significant milestones, decisions, blockers, or task switches.
Keep the next action specific, including the relevant file, function, and expected follow-up.
Refresh stale context before resuming if the notes are older than three days.
anti_patterns: Do not create waypoint plans for trivial one-line changes or purely mechanical cleanup.
Do not leave vague progress notes that omit the current file or next concrete action.
Do not store credentials, API keys, or other secrets in waypoint documentation.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps AI coding work survive context resets, interruptions, and handoffs by keeping structured project notes.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for work that spans multiple sessions, affects many files, or needs clear handoff documentation.

faq.question: What files does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends a plan file, a context file, and a tasks file for each active task.

faq.question: Does it execute commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance. Any command examples are workflow examples, not executable code in this skill.

faq.question: Can it replace issue tracking?
faq.answer: No. It complements issue trackers by preserving local implementation context and next actions.

faq.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Do not record secrets in waypoint files. Reference secure storage locations without copying sensitive values.
